title: chore(locators): rewrite locator parser with per-language parsers
body:
## Summary
- Replace the regex-based locator parser with a tokenizer and a recursive descent parser per language (JS, Python, Java, C#) that produces a `ParsedSelector` directly; each language maps its method names to shared call handlers.
- The parser validates methods, arguments and options itself, so the round-trip check through `asLocators` is removed. Also parses `and()`, `or()` and `locator(locator)`.
- Support multiple regex flags (`i`, `m`, `s`) in Python, Java and C# locators; the generators no longer drop `m` and `s`.
- Redundant engine prefixes are normalized, e.g. `locator('css=.foo')` now yields `.foo`.

References https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/42891
